description: This file defines the TcpConnector class, implementing the LinkConnector interface for TCP socket communication. It manages establishing TCP connections, sending data via a binary protocol, and handling connection states. The class includes methods for connecting, restarting, error checking, and retrieving available ports, as well as utility functions for parsing port strings and hostnames.

classes.name: TcpConnector
classes.description: A class that manages TCP socket connections, sending and receiving data using a binary protocol, and handling connection states.

classes.name: InvalidTcpPort
classes.description: Custom exception class for invalid TCP port strings.

methods.name: TcpConnector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connector with a specified port string, parsing for hostname and port.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection, sets up data listeners, and initializes the binary protocol.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Placeholder method for restarting the connection.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Returns false indicating no error state management implemented.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Returns the input packet as-is; placeholder for unpacking logic.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string through the binary protocol if connected.

methods.name: getAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list with the default port if the TCP port is available.

methods.name: isTcpPortOpened
methods.description: Checks if the default TCP port is open by attempting a socket connection.

methods.name: getTcpPort
methods.description: Parses the port number from a string, may throw InvalidTcpPort.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Extracts hostname from port string, defaults to localhost.
